name: Shobal
overview: Shobal was a male member of the tribe of Judah known primarily as the son of Hur. He is noted in Scripture for founding the city of Kiriath-jearim. Beyond this, there are no additional personal details or notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Shobal means "basket" in Hebrew. It is a proper name mentioned in 1 Chronicles 2:50 without indication that it was given by God, simply identifying him in the genealogical record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shobal as the son of Hur. There are inferred relationships suggesting Haroeh and Reaiah as fathers of related individuals, but these do not directly pertain to Shobal himself beyond his direct lineage from Hur.
scriptureSignificance: Shobal's significance lies in his role as a founder of Kiriath-jearim, a city of importance within the tribe of Judah. His mention in the genealogical records highlights the establishment and settlement patterns of Judah's descendants. Though briefly noted, his contribution to Israel's territorial history is preserved in 1 Chronicles 2:50.
